device.model: STHD-8800 Combo / GI 300 Black Synaps (System ID 06000A00, v1.5.74 gisclub.tv build)
device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T Full HD Combo receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, CI slot, 8-character VFD and Ethernet
device.board: 06000A00 (Fulansoft / Lemontree ALi M3602A VFD + EuP platform)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x33 + DVB-T COFDM
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / Galaxy Innovations (gisclub.tv Black Synaps mod)
source.note: Archive amiko_300_black synaps_gi_1.5.72_gisclub.tv.abs from AMIKO STHD-8800 COMBO; added for expanded coverage.

simulator.note: Boots as M3602 with chip ID 0x3602 (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_amiko_300_synaps_1574_app_starts.py, run_dump_amiko_300_synaps_1574_capture_screen.py): the "M3602A 1.1.6" bootloader exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM 38-byte PT6311 VFD frames with the Lemontree EuP standby and 8-character 14-segment VFD MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 62 (SCL) / 171 (SDA) ("  BOOT  " -> "        " -> "GISCLUB "), prints "APP  init ok", and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80008000.  The application prints "Version:06000A00_1.5.74 EMU", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and draws its Black Synaps GI OSD dialog through GeM3602.

desc: Amiko STHD-8800 Combo / GI 300 Black Synaps (v1.5.74 by gisclub.tv, System ID 06000A00) 4 MB SPI firmware for the ALi M3602A DVB-S2 + DVB-T Full HD Combo receiver.

Drives an 8-character 14-segment PT6311 VFD via the Lemontree EuP MCU on GPIO 62 / 171 ("  BOOT  " -> "GISCLUB "), ALi S3501 demodulator at I2C 0x33, Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and a 40-entry 0x44xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
